title: The Nicene Creed
subtitle: The Symbol of Faith of the First and Second Ecumenical Councils
intro: The Symbol of Faith confessed at Nicaea in 325 and completed at Constantinople in 381. The Church prays it at every Divine Liturgy and in the daily rule. It is offered here in more than one language; switch wordings with the tabs, each kept verbatim with its own source. The text carries no Filioque, as the Councils gave it.
source: Niceno-Constantinopolitan Creed (325/381). Public-domain liturgical texts; each wording cites its own source.

prayers.title: The Symbol of Faith
prayers.instruction: Said standing. One unbroken confession; the stanza breaks below are for reading only.
